steps.note: K1.a.1 states the row-by-row accounting (rows 0-1 remove the old scratch contribution, 2-5 add the source effect, 6-7 restore scratch) and the net change (JV+RG)x independent of the initial scratch vectors a,c, quoting line 749.

K1.a.2 gives the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, side injection cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, zero for intersections zero and two, and self coefficient one, as at lines 752-755.

K1.a.3 gives the complex central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 with the side wires cancelling intersections zero and two, intersection one contributing zero and self coefficient one, matching lines 756-758.
K1.b states the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) with each invocation restoring its own auxiliary wires, and K1's method gives the forward/inverse/forward schedule.
K3.A.2 asserts that every edge joins comparable nondegenerate labels, but the plan never gives the per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions (the residual table of lines 1021-1043).
The side edge 2->5 and the argument that t_X perp t_Y gives <t_X> inside t_Y^perp with complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2 appear nowhere in the plan.

K3.A.2 names center 3->4 as the only decreasing edges, each losing h (L=Ich), and K3.A.1 with K3.A's gate-cancellation motivation gives sources N, sinks Wm-N, signed Wm-2N and absolute Wm-2N+2L, as at lines 1061-1071 (quoted from the paper's restatements at 891 and 998).

S3.1.b uses an orthonormal basis of each edge residual, but the plan never argues over F_2 that each nonzero residual is nondegenerate and nonalternating, nor the absorption of alternating planes that yields the basis.
K3.A.3 states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, quoting line 1107.

The plan never states that weight is additive mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors or the formula q_V-q_U = sum wt(v)[v.x] over an orthonormal residual basis; S3.1/S3.1.b only assert the resulting product of kernels.
S3.1.b asserts the frame change is a product of (aI+bX_v)^{eps}, but the derivation (odd weight giving the phase i^{eps[v.x]}, turned into a translation kernel by H diag(1,-1) H = X) is missing.

S3.1.b gives one directional kernel per residual basis vector, and S3.1.d/S3.3.a state that each residual vector yields one child call acting on all f columns of a slot, exactly s_c in all, which is the content of lines 1262-1271 as reused at 1905.

S3.1.e only says that 'source and sink corrections' and undoing the exchange give C^{tensor e}; the endpoint frames I and C^{tensor m}, the C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a), the Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} repair and the negation of the X outputs are not stated.
K3.A.3 gives both loss ratios below 1/2 and K3.B.4 states the deficit N-2L_b>0 because L_b<N/2, hence s_b<W_b m.
The exact value eta_b = 339/22587335000000 does not appear in the plan.
The exact value eta_c = 73/19906842167500 does not appear in the plan.
K3.C states that the relative deficit exceeds 20*2^{-50} and log m<20, so m^{1-2^{-50}} > m(1-20*2^{-50}) > m(1-eta) and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, quoting line 1336; S6.1.a gives tau=sigma.

K4 states the factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones only as the lemma statement (quote line 1366); the elimination proof (topmost nonzero row, rightmost pivot, lower-triangular clearing, repetition on active indices) is not given.
The plan works over Z/q^b but never states the choice of a fixed odd prime avoiding every denominator in the finite table so that the identities specialize with invertible triangular factors.

K5.a states that a lower triangular transformation of H or D costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order, multiplying by a diagonal unit and adding a fixed combination of earlier coordinates.
K5.c gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, an interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j for each one of Pi, with exactly a interchanges since Pi has a ones, and K5.b gives the surrounding triangular transformations.

The plan defines E=64(W+m+1)^3 (S3.4.a), B=s+E and nu (S3.4.b), Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) (S3.4.c) and C_1=20 (S6.1.a), but never defines C_0=128mB^2 or C_1=max{20,nu+3}, so the guard constant Delta is left depending on an undefined C_0; judged absent as incomplete.

S3.4.a states A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E at an internal node and A(e)<=8e at a leaf with E=64(W+m+1)^3, and why s (not s/W) appears; the itemized per-invocation count below E is not spelled out, but the recurrence is.
S3.4.b gives the unrolled chain A(e)<=8dB^{k+1}<=8B^2 d^{nu+1} with B and nu defined, quoting line 2534; the final comparison of the concatenated total with C_0 d^{C_1} is not stated.

S3.4.c states that depth ell gives values in 2^{-(p+ell)}Z[i] of modulus at most 2^ell so p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits are exact, and S3.4.d that epsilon C_1<1 with d=Theta(p^epsilon) gives Delta=o(p).
S3.6 states that every row of H has absolute row sum one so disks are preserved and truncation changes each component by less than 2^{-p}, and S3.5 gives the error below sqrt2 2^{-p}.

summary: P11 carries the bank-exchange network fully (B1-B4), the telescoping budget and loss ratios (L3, L5), the rank deficit and exponent bound (R1, R4), the shear implementation (M3, M4), the phase-call count (P3) and most of the guard-width argument (S2-S5): 15 of 26 present, none wrong. It omits the residual table, the side-edge argument and the orthonormal-basis proof (L1, L2, L4), the phase derivation and endpoint repair (P1, P2, P4), the exact deficits (R2, R3), the elimination proof and prime choice (M1, M2), and leaves C_0 undefined in the constants (S1).
